output.summary: A perennial red seaweed whose attached form is widely distributed on both sides of the North Atlantic. It occurs in attached and drifting forms and can create dense underwater belts that provide spawning habitat for many fish. It is commercially harvested as a source of carrageenan.
output.edibilityNote: Furcellaran extracted from this seaweed is used to add texture to foods such as sweets, ice cream and puddings.
